world.title: In 1988, Ohio attorney Neil McKown secretly bought 155 neglected acres; 38 years later, the family farms nearly 500 acres and he declined a $400,000-$500,000 timber cut to keep the woods
world.summary: In 1988, Ohio attorney Neil McKown purchased 155 acres of neglected land in Shelby. Over 38 years, his family expanded their farming operations to nearly 500 acres. Recently, McKown declined a timber cut offer valued between $400,000 and $500,000, choosing instead to preserve the wooded areas on the property, reflecting his commitment to land conservation.

world.title: Afghanistan says 28 fighters killed after crossing from Pakistan; Islamabad denies ties
world.summary: Afghanistan's defense ministry reported that its forces killed 28 fighters and wounded 32 in Nuristan province after a group, including Islamic State militants, allegedly crossed from Pakistan. The incident has heightened tensions, with Islamabad denying any involvement or ties to the fighters. The situation reflects ongoing security challenges in the region amid rising concerns over cross-border militant activity.

world.title: 20-year-old Azerbaijani woman allegedly drugged, gang-raped in Pakistan's Lahore
world.summary: A 20-year-old woman from Azerbaijan was allegedly drugged and gang-raped by three men in Lahore, Pakistan. The incident occurred after she was taken to a flat in the Defence Housing Authority area. Authorities have registered a case against the accused, who have been booked for the alleged crime. The investigation is ongoing, with further details pending.

business.title: India investment future: FIIs remain net sellers in Sept 2026 but these 5 factors can bring them back - Experts decode
business.summary: Foreign institutional investors (FIIs) have sold a net ₹18,531 crore in Indian equities in September 2026, marking six consecutive weeks of net selling. In contrast, domestic institutional investors (DIIs) have invested ₹52,617 crore during the same period. Experts suggest that five specific factors could potentially encourage FIIs to return to the Indian market in the future.

business.title: New mobile recharge rules: 30-day plans, call-only options and more; TRAI rules explained
business.summary: The Telecom Regulatory Authority of India (TRAI) has introduced new rules for prepaid mobile users, enhancing recharge options under a consumer protection framework. The changes include 30-day plans and specific call-only options. These adjustments aim to provide greater flexibility and choice for users, ensuring they can select plans that better meet their communication needs and preferences.

business.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Monday
business.summary: Indian equity benchmarks Sensex and Nifty closed higher on Friday, at 73,896 and 23,140.50, respectively. Geojit’s Vinod Nair noted that strong domestic liquidity is supporting Nifty above 23,000. However, elevated crude oil prices and ongoing foreign outflows are limiting near-term market gains. Investors are closely monitoring these factors ahead of trading on Monday.

technology.title: W Cricket Scorecard, Final at Minas Gerias, September 27, 2026
technology.summary: Brazil A Women faced Costa Rica Women in the final of the South American Women's Championships on September 27, 2026. The match saw several wickets fall, with Lavinia Silva out for 17 runs, Gabrieli Da Silva for 44, and Ana Bessoni for 63. Other dismissals included Hilary Iaccino, Eloise Thomaz, and Gabriela Bernardes, contributing to the team's total.

technology.title: Pixel 11, Pixel 11 Pro and Pixel 11 Pro Fold Get Discounts in Google Birthday Sale
technology.summary: The Google Birthday Sale 2026 offers significant discounts on the Pixel 11, Pixel 11 Pro, Pixel 11 Pro XL, and Pixel 11 Pro Fold, alongside bank and exchange offers. The Pixel 11, featuring the upgraded Tensor G6 chipset, is originally priced at Rs 89,999, with an instant discount of Rs 7,000 available during the sale.

technology.title: Renowned wrestler 'The Great Khali' pays courtesy visit to Governor
technology.summary: Renowned wrestler Dalip Singh Rana, known as 'The Great Khali', visited Governor Kavinder Gupta at Lok Bhavan in Shimla on September 27, 2026. The meeting was a courtesy visit, during which the Governor welcomed the WWE Hall of Famer. The visit highlights Khali's prominence in the wrestling community and his connection to Indian culture and sports.

sports.title: Uzbekistan, China Win 2026 Samarkand Chess Olympiad Gold
sports.summary: Uzbekistan secured its second gold medal at the 46th Chess Olympiad 2026 held in Samarkand, achieving victory on home soil. The team triumphed over Ukraine with a score of 2.5-1.5, thanks to GM Mukhiddin Madaminov's decisive win. India earned the silver medal, while Germany claimed bronze, marking a competitive event in the chess community.

sports.title: Asian Games Aichi-Nagoya 2026: True to his word, Thailand's Puripol Boonson matches Asian record in men's 200m
sports.summary: Thailand's Puripol Boonson, 20, matched the Asian record in the men's 200m by clocking 19.88 seconds at the Asian Games Aichi-Nagoya. This achievement follows his victory in the 100m, completing a sprint double. Boonson's performance underscores his status as Asia's top sprinter, tying the record previously held by Xie Zhenye.

sports.title: late night, early start and Asian Games exit
sports.summary: PV Sindhu faced a challenging schedule at the Asian Games, with a late finish and early start impacting her performance. In the quarterfinal against Chen Yufei, Sindhu initially showcased strong play but ultimately lost the match with scores of 21-11, 18-21, and 10-21. The demanding timeline contributed to her inability to recover effectively before the match.

health.title: High blood pressure? Why cutting salt and eating more potassium could work better
health.summary: A recent US study in The American Journal of Clinical Nutrition indicates that increasing potassium intake may be more effective in managing high blood pressure than simply reducing sodium intake. Low potassium levels can exacerbate sodium's harmful effects, contributing to hypertension. The findings suggest that a balanced diet rich in potassium could play a crucial role in cardiovascular health.

health.title: Experts discuss vaccine schedules, missed doses and common misconceptions
health.summary: Experts at The Hindu’s Health Webinar Series discussed vaccine schedules, catch-up immunisation, travel vaccines, and safety concerns. The session, titled ‘Vaccines: Armour Against Infectious Diseases,’ addressed common misconceptions surrounding immunisation. Doctors emphasized the importance of adhering to vaccination schedules and the need for catch-up vaccinations for those who missed doses, aiming to enhance public understanding of vaccine-related issues.

health.title: Can stress really trigger a heart attack? Doctors explain
health.summary: Cardiovascular disease was responsible for approximately 19.8 million deaths worldwide in 2022, making it a leading cause of mortality. In India, heart attack fatalities increased to 35,715 in 2023, with the Indian Heart Association reporting that half of heart attacks in Indian men now occur before the age of 50, highlighting a significant public health concern.

science.title: New soil test could reveal how soil microbes help feed plants
science.summary: Scientists have developed a streamlined method for measuring DNA-bound phosphorus in soil, enhancing cost-effectiveness and accuracy. This technique aims to uncover how soil microbes recycle phosphorus, which is vital for plant growth and food production. Understanding phosphorus dynamics in soil is crucial for sustainable fertilizer management and maintaining fertile farmland, especially given the limited natural phosphorus reserves worldwide.

science.title: Icy moons unlikely to lose their underground oceans easily
science.summary: Simulations indicate that large icy moons in the outer solar system are capable of reforming and retaining their subsurface oceans despite experiencing significant collisions. These moons, which have endured numerous impacts over their 4.5 billion-year history, demonstrate resilience, suggesting that even substantial impacts may not easily lead to the loss of their underground oceans.

science.title: NASA Moves PRIMA Telescope Into Preliminary Design Phase
science.summary: NASA has officially advanced the PRobe far-Infrared Mission for Astrophysics (PRIMA) into Phase B, initiating its preliminary design and technology development. This phase marks a significant step in the project, which aims to enhance our understanding of the universe through far-infrared observations. The decision reflects NASA's commitment to advancing astrophysical research and developing innovative space technologies.

entertainment.title: Rani Mukerji's mother Krishna Mukerji's Chautha ceremony: Shah Rukh Khan, Aamir Khan, Jaya-Shweta Bachchan and other celebs attend the prayer meet
entertainment.summary: Rani Mukerji's family hosted a Chautha ceremony for her late mother, Krishna Mukerji, who died on September 22 after a brief illness. The prayer meet was attended by notable celebrities, including Shah Rukh Khan, Aamir Khan, and Jaya and Shweta Bachchan. Krishna Mukerji, a former playback singer, was 75 years old at the time of her passing.

entertainment.title: Ajay Devgn Takes A Dig At Kapil Sharma's Drinking Past On The Great Indian Kapil Show
entertainment.summary: Ajay Devgn appeared on The Great Indian Kapil Show to promote "Drishyam: The Conclusion," alongside Shriya Saran, Jaideep Ahlawat, Ishita Dutta, and Mrunal Jadhav. During the episode, Kapil Sharma humorously referenced Ajay's ties to Goa. In response, Ajay made a light-hearted remark about Kapil's past with drinking, adding a playful tone to their conversation.

entertainment.title: Swara Bhasker slams trolling over her post-pregnancy weight gain
entertainment.summary: Actor Swara Bhasker addressed online trolling related to her post-pregnancy weight gain, expressing her frustration over body-shaming comments. Bhasker and her partner, Fahad Ahmad, recently welcomed their daughter, Raabiyaa. She highlighted the negative impact of such comments on mental health and emphasized the importance of body positivity and acceptance, urging society to be more supportive of new mothers.
